instruction.text: Ordne die Phrasen in die richtigen Kategorien ein.
Wähle die passenden Antworten aus. Mehrere Antworten können richtig sein.

atoms.a: Wie kannst du dir etwas nochmal erklären lassen?

b: ++You bring up a very good point.
Could you explain that again, please?

instruction.text: Ergänze die Antworten auf die Fragen.

atoms.a: I would love to have a rabbit!
atoms.b: ((++I_know,_but I_believe)) do you have enough space and time for it?
atoms.sound: I would love to have a rabbit! <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>I know, but do you have enough space and time for it?</voice>

atoms.a: Have you ever had the feeling that you could control your dreams?
atoms.b: I don't quite ((++understand agree)). Could you explain that?
atoms.sound: Have you ever had the feeling that you could control your dreams? <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>I don't quite understand. Could you explain that?</voice>

atoms.a: You didn't water the plants yesterday.
atoms.b: ((++You're_wrong You're_right)), I did water them yesterday.
atoms.sound: You didn't water the plants yesterday. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>You're wrong, I did water them yesterday.</voice>

atoms.a: Do you think the dog can jump over the fence?
atoms.b: ((++I_would_say I_see)) so, but he wouldn't do it.
atoms.sound: Do you think the dog can jump over the fence? <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>I would say so, but he wouldn't do it.</voice>

atoms.a: For me, summer is the best season!
atoms.sound: For me, summer is the best season! <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>I agree, I love the heat.</voice>

atoms.a: I think it would be good if we'd eat lunch now.
atoms.sound: I think it would be good if we'd eat lunch now.<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>I disagree, I'm not yet hungry.</voice>
